subject: Adoption playbook & responsibility grid — Novena Health MAP
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Claire Mason <claire.mason@novenahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Adoption playbook & responsibility grid — Novena Health MAP

Hi Claire —

Great to speak this morning. Per our conversation, attached is a first-pass adoption playbook and the responsibility grid (Novena_MAP_v1.xlsx). The goal here is to align on milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria so we can lock in a firm go-live window. Top-level proposal:

- Kickoff workshop (week of Sep 6) — high-level goals, data flows, success metrics. Owner: Novena & Redwood PMs.
- Sandbox integration (2 weeks) — API keys, sample payloads, KV cache expectations. Owner: Novena Eng + Redwood Integration.
- Security & compliance review (SOC2 artifacts, retention settings) — concurrent with sandbox. Owner: Procurement + Security.
- Pilot (2 weeks) — defined prompt set, quality gates, latency targets. Owner: Novena CS + Redwood CS.
- Production cutover & 30-day support window — post-acceptance. Owner: Novena Ops + Redwood Support.

Please find the Responsibility Grid tab in the spreadsheet: yellow = Novena action, blue = Redwood action, green = joint. I called out suggested milestone dates on column F; these are draft and flexible but will help structure resourcing.

Immediate asks:
1) Can you confirm procurement lead and preferred contract turnaround (standard PO vs DocuSign)?
2) Are there any blackout dates in Sep-Oct for your engineering or security teams?
3) Confirm a preferred kickoff date week for Sep 6 or Sep 13.

I copied Marissa (CS lead) and Jonas (solutions) to start assignment of internal owners. We’ll iterate the spreadsheet and lock the MAP before the kickoff.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

[Attachment: Novena_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: Novena_API_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Claire Mason <claire.mason@novenahealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Adoption playbook & responsibility grid — Novena Health MAP

Thanks, Olga — and thanks for the recap. The plan looks sensible. A few notes from my side:

- Procurement: Sarah Lopez (procurement@novenahealth.com) will own contracts. We prefer DocuSign but can accept a PO for the first invoice.
- Security review: we’ll need an evidence snapshot for data retention and audit logs. Can your team supply the SOC2 envelope and an example retention policy?
- Kickoff: Sep 13 is better for our team (we have a board offsite the week of Sep 6).

Two asks:
1) Can you tighten the sandbox window to a single-week spike (Sep 20–24) instead of two weeks? Our engineers are strapped; we’d prefer a focused spike.
2) For the pilot prompt set, I’ll share a small set of 25 canonical prompts — will that be sufficient to validate quality gates?

If we can get the MAP finalized this week, I’ll schedule Sarah and our security lead for the kickoff.

—Claire
Claire Mason
Head of Digital Services | Novena Health
claire.mason@novenahealth.com | +1 917-555-2233

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-25T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Adoption playbook & responsibility grid — Novena Health MAP

Folks — forwarding Claire's confirmation. Key changes to incorporate into MAP v1.1:

- Kickoff moved to week of Sep 13 (Novena board offsite Sep 6).
- Sandbox: customer requests a focused 1-week spike (Sep 20–24).
- Procurement lead: Sarah Lopez (DocuSign preferred).
- Security: need SOC2 artifacts + retention example. Claire expects evidence snapshot during sandbox week.

Action items for Redwood (please reply with owner & ETA):
- Ben: confirm we can compress sandbox to 1-week spike and outline what we deliver during that spike (API keys, example ingestion script, sample payloads, latency profile).
- Marissa: prepare pilot success criteria doc (quality gates, top-line acceptance matrix). Can you scope by EOD Friday?
- Jonas: pre-kickoff runbook — templates for demo prompts, SSO checklist, and estimated eng effort for pilot adjustments. Draft by next Tue (Aug 31) please.

I’ll update the spreadsheet (Novena_MAP_v1.xlsx) after we have owner ETAs. CC’ing Claire so she can see internal owners.

Thanks —
Olga

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Adoption playbook & responsibility grid — Novena Health MAP

Quick updates on owners/commitments:

- Sandbox compression: confirmed — we can run a targeted 5-day spike (Sep 20–24). Deliverables during spike: API key (sandbox), example ingestion script (Python), sample payload validator, basic latency stress report (95th perc). Owner: Integration SWAT (Ben).
- Pilot success criteria: Marissa will own. Marissa — agreed on 25 prompts as initial set; aim for 85% pass on quality gates (subject to review).
- Pre-kickoff runbook: Jonas will share the SSO checklist and demo templates by Tuesday Aug 31.
- SOC2 artifacts: I attached a redacted SOC2 snapshot we can share. Also attaching the onboarding checklist PDF for Novena procurement.

I updated Novena_MAP_v1.xlsx (Responsibility Grid column updates and redlined milestone dates). Will push v1.1 to the Drive link and attach here.
